note: Removed from the live directory because the listed cycle had closed. Re-add when the sponsor reopens.

items.name: Jack Kent Cooke Foundation College Scholarship
items.description: U.S. high school seniors graduating spring 2027 and entering an accredited four-year college in fall 2027; minimum unweighted GPA 3.75, required SAT/ACT/AP/IB test score, and financial need with family income reviewed up to $95,000.

items.name: U.S. Bank Student Scholarship Program
items.description: Legal U.S. residents age 17+, accepted or enrolled in an eligible undergraduate college or trade/vocational program. Financial education modules required; a sweepstakes rather than a need-based award.

items.name: Chick-fil-A Community Scholars Program
items.description: Thirteen $25,000 awards recognize students for academic success, community service and financial need. Includes a one-year leadership development and mentoring program; review the sponsor application for full eligibility.

items.name: VFW Voice of Democracy Scholarship Contest
items.description: For eligible students in grades 9–12. Submit an original audio essay on the current patriotic theme with an entry form through a participating local VFW Post. National, state and local awards vary.
items.deadlineLabel: October 31, 2026, midnight; submit through your participating VFW Post

items.name: Coca-Cola Scholars Program
items.description: Achievement-based awards recognizing leadership and service among eligible students in their final year of high school. The program selects 150 students for $20,000 awards; current citizenship/residency, GPA and school requirements apply.
items.deadlineLabel: 2027 application is closed; check sponsor for next cycle

items.name: The Gates Scholarship
items.description: A highly selective, last-dollar scholarship for outstanding high school seniors from low-income households. Check the official application for current eligibility, funding coverage, required materials and deadlines.
items.deadlineLabel: 2027-cycle deadline was September 15, 2026 (opened July 15, 2026); now closed — check sponsor for next cycle

items.name: QuestBridge National College Match
items.description: Connects high-achieving high school seniors from low-income backgrounds with partner colleges and full four-year Match Scholarships. Review citizenship, academic and financial criteria and the binding Match process before ranking colleges.
items.deadlineLabel: 2026 Match applicants have been selected as Finalists; check sponsor for next entry cycle

items.name: Elks MVS Scholarship
items.description: Current high school seniors who are U.S. citizens and plan full-time four-year undergraduate study at an accredited U.S. college. Elks membership/relationship not required.

items.name: Hispanic Scholarship Fund Scholar Program
items.description: Merit-selected HSF Scholars receive support services and may receive a cash award based on need and available funding. Hispanic-heritage students must meet citizenship/residency, GPA and full-time enrollment requirements; a Scholar designation does not guarantee a cash award.
items.deadlineLabel: 2026 application closed; check sponsor for the next cycle

items.name: YoungArts
items.description: A national visual, literary and performing arts competition for eligible students in grades 10–12 or ages 15–18, with U.S. citizenship, residency or taxable-income eligibility requirements. Winners receive cash awards and career/mentorship support.
items.deadlineLabel: Current application closed; next 2028 application opens summer 2027

items.name: Hispanic Heritage Youth Awards
items.amount: Gold/Silver/Bronze one-time innovation grants per category (amount not published; funds can go toward college or a community-service project)
items.description: For high school seniors (unweighted GPA 3.0+ on a 4.0 scale, or 7.5+ on a 10.0 scale) graduating spring 2027 and planning to enroll at an accredited higher-education institution in 2027-2028. Recognizes leadership and achievement across categories such as STEM, business/entrepreneurship, education, and the arts; selected honorees must attend a virtual regional awards ceremony.
items.deadlineLabel: November 1, 2026 (current cycle; now closed — check sponsor for next cycle)

items.name: New York Excelsior Scholarship Program
items.amount: Last-dollar award covering tuition at a SUNY or CUNY college after other aid (e.g., Pell, TAP) is applied, for 2–5 years depending on the degree program
items.description: For U.S. citizens or eligible noncitizens with 12 continuous months of New York State residency, household combined federal adjusted gross income of $125,000 or less, pursuing an undergraduate degree full-time (12+ credits/term, 30+ credits/year) at a SUNY or CUNY college. Non-residents, including undocumented students, apply through the NYS DREAM Act instead. Recipients who move out of New York after graduating must repay the award as a loan, and award years used count against a service/residency requirement to live and work in New York after graduation.
items.deadlineLabel: The NYS Excelsior Scholarship program is now closed for the 2026-27 academic year — check hesc.ny.gov for the next application window

items.name: Tennessee Promise
items.amount: Last-dollar scholarship covering tuition and mandatory fees not covered by the Pell Grant, HOPE Scholarship, or Tennessee Student Assistance Award at Tennessee's community colleges, Colleges of Applied Technology, or eligible four-year institutions offering an associate degree
items.description: For Tennessee high school seniors (class of 2027) who complete the TN Promise application, attend a mandatory meeting coordinated by their partnering mentoring organization (the Ayers Foundation Trust or tnAchieves, depending on county), submit the 2027-28 FAFSA by April 1, 2027, enroll full-time starting spring 2027, and complete 16 hours of community service (first 16 hours due August 1, 2027).
items.deadlineLabel: Class of 2027 application was due November 2, 2026 — now closed; check collegefortn.org/TNPromise for the next cycle
